map.插座类型编码为 A 至 O（A 两扁脚、B 两扁脚加地线、C 两圆脚、G 三方脚: Socket types are coded from A to O (A: two flat pins, B: two flat pins plus ground, C: two round pins, G: three rectangular pins, and so on). Nominal voltage ranges from 100 to 240 V at 50 or 60 Hz. Compatibility is judged by whether the plug shape matches and whether the voltage falls within the device input range (100 to 240 V). A voltage mismatch requires a transformer, where power = voltage × current; exceeding the transformer's rated power causes overload.

map.日本用 A/B 型两脚扁插、电压 100V；中国两脚插头可直插但需变压器（100: Japan uses type A and B two-pin flat plugs at 100 V. A two-pin Chinese plug fits directly, but a transformer is required (do not connect 100 V devices to 220 V).
map.英国/港/新用 G 型三方扁插、230-240V，需带转换器；工具按国名检索插头: The UK, Hong Kong and Singapore use type G three-pin flat plugs at 230 to 240 V, so a converter is needed; the tool looks up plug type and voltage by country name.

map.插头形状对不等于电压对，100/120V 设备赴 220V 国须变压器，否则烧毁: A matching plug shape does not mean a matching voltage. Taking 100/120 V devices to a 220 V country requires a transformer, otherwise they burn out.
